sloka: यमो वैश्रवणः शक्रो वरुणश्च महाबलः ।विशेष्यन्ते नरेन्द्रेण वृत्तेन महाता ततः ॥२-६७-३५॥
transliteration: yamo vaiśravaṇaḥ śakro varuṇaśca mahābalaḥ ।viśeṣyante narendreṇa vṛttena mahātā tataḥ ॥2-67-35॥

translations.english: Hence, the king with his excellent conduct surpasses mighty Yama, Vaisravana, Indra and Varuna.
